artifacts.title: Small stories about night-shift objects
artifacts.content: Write a series of short printed fiction pieces told from the point of view of objects left behind in all-night diners. Each story should stand alone and fit on two pages.

artifacts.title: Keep the stories on the page
artifacts.content: The first booklet is a collection of written scenes with small black-and-white illustrations. A reader should be able to open any page and finish one object's story in a few minutes.

artifacts.title: Trying the scenes aloud
artifacts.content: Read three scenes aloud at the studio. Pauses and changes in narrator made some objects feel as if they were answering one another. This was a reading test; the next print booklet is still planned.

artifacts.title: A two-voice pilot
artifacts.content: Recorded a short pilot in which the receipt and the coffee cup tell connected versions of one night. The illustrated text version will remain available alongside the audio experiment.
